propositions: LLMRunnerError raised by step-budget exhaustion does not match the except clause that catches only UnretryableOutputError, so bounded completion recovery is unreachable when budget is exhausted
A new typed exception LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) must be raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to make budget exhaustion identifiable by type rather than by diagnostic shape
CompletionAgentStep.run's except clause must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover, enabling the per-criterion recovery logic for budget exhaustion
The budget diagnostic must be preserved on self.failure_diagnostic before recovery so that if recovery also fails, the loop-vs-breadth counters are available to raise_completion_workflow_failure

Bounded recovery isolates each criterion in a fresh agentic history with evidence runs at 16 steps and a tool-free structured finalizer, and is the only mechanism that addresses budget exhaustion correctly
